doubts: Airbnb release time (pre-market vs after close) is not in the filing; base earnings dates 2021-02-25 and 2021-05-13 are taken as releases whose 'second trading day immediately following' is the next-but-one session, later date used (Mar 1; May 17). If pre-market and the release day counts as the first, dates would be Feb 26 and May 14.

Tranche t2 needs three conditions the schema holds in one trigger: release on 2nd trading day after first earnings, close >= 133% of $68 (= $90.44) on 10 of the 15 full trading days ending the first full trading day after the release AND at that day's close, and not before 60 days after prospectus (Feb 7, 2021). Checked: all 15 closes (Feb 5-26, 2021) are above $182, so it releases; extra fields on trigger record this.

Tranche percentages are of the Employee Stockholder's holdings counted on Nov 30, 2020 (t2 also adds shares vested to Feb 25, 2021 and any unsold t1 shares); 15/25/60 is an approximation. An early employee who is party to the Investors Rights Agreement is excluded from t1/t2 and would follow the founder group.
t1 is a 7-trading-day window (Dec 10-21, 2020); the window closes after day 7 and unsold t1 shares carry into t2. resolvedDate is the first day the shares may be sold.
